problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{1}{2(x+1)}?$

feedback.problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{2}{x-1}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To plot $y=\frac{2}{x-1},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=\frac{1}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/e80865b0f32a5473da27b39537034bcdabee0a6c24032f41413e20518642d3f4.png)

- Translate it by $1$ unit to the right to get the graph of $y=\frac{1}{x-1}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/8f2a42430ac31a559e5f85c961579aa482280bd9b69ed5d948250f5fafce21a5.png)

- Then, stretch the result by a scale factor of $2$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=\frac{2}{x-1}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/4309ca72d59724e15c2e6087518983d66dd8665af5ee058a0dc13b04cdd11d5c.png)
